name: stub-routing-falsifier
comment: ADR-067 Stage 3 standing falsifier: a Claude reference stub must reach the canonical .agents body. Grown, never edited in place. If a live session routed to a stubbed skill fails to reach the canonical body, revert the stub decision and reopen Stage 3b/3c.

cases.trigger: an agent-confirmed code defect is being left unfixed this session
writing a new skill, changing a canonical SKILL.md, or promoting a procedure candidate into .agents/skills/
before writing verified, enforced, complete, never, or measured
a test whose value is that it would fail, or a pre-dispatch gate
works in setup X and fails in setup Y
